sessions.label: Hack am Rhein challenge cultivation
open_questions: Which challenge contains the most interesting broken decision rather than the most obvious technology build?
Where can making information actionable create a genuinely useful intervention?
Can cause-centred stakeholder mapping and deciding without agreeing become a strong Basel-at-38 concept?
Which ideas should be tested before selecting a challenge?

decisions.text: Keep official challenge wording separate from brainstorm interpretation so ideas do not silently rewrite the brief.
Use the repository as a challenge garden: cultivate multiple ideas before selecting what to build.
